# phron_storage_overview (Data Source)

The state, endpoint, usage and price of a Workspace's Object Storage. Safe to read before any storage exists (state "not_created").

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "phron_storage_overview" "this" {
  location = "fsn1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `location` (String) The Location of the storage, when the Workspace has storage in more than one.
- `workspace_id` (String) The Workspace; empty means the Organization's default Workspace.

### Read-Only

- `bucket_count` (Number) Number of buckets.
- `bucket_name_prefix` (String) The text every bucket name of a shared Cell starts with.
- `currency` (String) The ISO 4217 currency of month_to_date_cost.
- `endpoint_url` (String) The S3 endpoint; empty until the storage exists.
- `id` (String) The Workspace id the overview describes.
- `key_count` (Number) Number of Storage Access Keys.
- `locations` (Attributes List) Every Location, with whether new storage can be created there now. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--locations))
- `month_to_date_cost` (String) Storage charges so far this calendar month, in the currency below.
- `object_count` (Number) Number of objects.
- `price_per_gb_month_usd` (String) The price per GB-month in USD.
- `region` (String) The S3 signing region.
- `state` (String) The storage state, for example "active" or "not_created".
- `stored_bytes` (Number) Logical stored bytes (what is billed).

<a id="nestedatt--locations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `locations`

Read-Only:

- `available` (Boolean) Whether something new can be created there now.
- `country` (String) The country.
- `id` (String) The Location id, as resources take it in `location`.
- `name` (String) The city.
- `unavailable_reason` (String) Why not, when available is false.
